portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.  

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use 
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
The Apache Portable Runtime is a portability library used by the Apache
HTTP Server and other projects.

A build issue in the apr package prevented correct generation of the
"-debuginfo" subpackage.

Users requiring the -debuginfo subpackage should upgrade to these updated
packages, which resolve this issue.
